high_level_description: The image depicts a formal interaction between two individuals in what appears to be a ceremonial or diplomatic setting. The person on the left is dressed in traditional papal attire, including a white cassock, a zucchetto (a small skullcap), and a white mitre (a type of hat worn by bishops). This individual is also wearing a cross necklace and is seated on a simple, light-colored chair. The person on the right is dressed in a dark suit with a red tie, suggesting a formal or official role. The two individuals are shaking hands, indicating a gesture of greeting or agreement.
